A '''hotel''' operated business in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] district during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] once stayed at the hotel while plotting a rescue mission of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the clutches of [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.
